edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E-Q stun package banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Rocket Grab (Q): 20/19/18/17/16s CD — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim while it's up. - Power Fist (E) auto-resets for burst; the wind-up is your cue to step back. - Mana Barrier (P) shields his low-HP all-in — force it out first.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Bait or dodge Rocket Grab, then W-Q-ignite the naked Blitzcrank before his ~16-20s cooldown resets.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
edits.after: Rocket Grab down (16-20s CD) means no engage — that is your all-in window, not a poke one.
